learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, enabling them to learn new methods and theories, and providing them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to analyze and assess the social and environmental impact of technical solutions.
Ability to apply quality principles and methods.
Applied knowledge of manufacturing systems and processes, metrology, and quality control.

syllabus_topics: Topic 1: Powder processing techniques for ceramics and metals.
Topic 2: Manufacturing processes used in polymers.
Topic 3: Manufacturing processes used in composites.
assessment_rules: Overall evaluation is continuous. The weighted average of Written Test 1 (PE1, 70%) and Written Test 2 (PE2, 30%) must be 5.0 or higher. A minimum score of 5.0 is also required for Laboratory Practices (SE3). Students failing in the ordinary call can retake unpassed re-evaluable activities in the extraordinary call. For PE1 and PE2, re-evaluation combines them into a single exam, while the SE3 grade is maintained. Attendance to written tests and laboratory practices is mandatory.
